name: Ballard Smith
bio: A Representative from Virginia; born in Hanover County, Va., birth date unknown; served as lieutenant in the Army during the Revolutionary War; member of the Virginia state house of delegates, 1810-1813; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Fourteenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (March 4, 1815-March 3, 1821); again a member of the Virginia state house of delegates, 1824-1826, 1836, and 1837; death date unknown.
